purpose: Teach: 目印/織物/運気/箇条/羅列/撫で/止む/アコースティック

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店の、本気で、絶対、目印、絶対、青い看板、絶対、なのよ
lines.en: Sho, look—my shop has the blue sign as the landmark, okay? Absolutely.
lines.style: Warm, gentle insistence. Speak to him at eye level. Soft emphasis on the blue sign detail—she's making sure he remembers. Patient repetition, not scolding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、社会科で、絶対、織物、絶対、習ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really did learn about weaving in social studies!
lines.style: Bright, earnest eagerness to share. Lean forward slightly. Small child's pride in remembering something grown-up. Quick tempo, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、運気、絶対、上がるように、絶対、お参り、絶対、行ってきたわ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, I went to the shrine to pray that my luck would turn around.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Slight pause before the confession. Tender vulnerability—trusting him with something sincere. Slower pace, trailing off gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、宿題を、絶対、箇条書きに、絶対、して、絶対、整理したよ、メイ姉さん
lines.en: I organized my homework into bullet points, Mei-sis. All neat.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride in his voice. Straightforward delivery—no performance. Quick, direct. Looking for her approval quietly, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、好きな本の名、絶対、羅列、絶対、ノートに、絶対、書いているのよ、翔くん
lines.en: I've been writing down all the names of my favorite books in a notebook.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy quality. Slow pace. She's sharing something that matters to her—a quiet ritual. Slight warmth in the voice, like she's letting him see something private.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの頭、絶対、撫でて、絶対、くれる?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, will you pet my head for me? Please?
lines.style: Small, hopeful voice. Quiet request—not demanding. Childlike trust. Eyes up at her. Slight vulnerability at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今日の雨、本気で、絶対、午後には、絶対、止む、絶対、らしいわよ、翔くん
lines.en: The rain today should clear up by this afternoon, I think.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Conversational, not urgent. Warm glance toward the window. Soft reassurance hidden in the detail—she's paying attention to his day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、アコースティック、絶対、ギター、絶対、聴かせてよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, will you play that acoustic guitar for me? Please?
lines.style: Hopeful child's request. Soft voice, genuine desire. Not negotiating—simply asking. Close, tender delivery. Eyes brightening at the thought.
